cluster_policy: Clusters are deterministic document-structure and visual-format groups formed before any candidate mining. A single representative page is frozen from each related or near-duplicate group; cluster membership does not assert a case label.

clusters.cluster_basis: Chapter 1 wood-structure repair plates showing spar/splice methods with section views and lettered dimensions/callouts.
clusters.representative_reason: Figure 1-8 provides a distinct box-spar flange splice arrangement while avoiding multiple consecutive wood-spar plates.

clusters.cluster_basis: Chapter 3 composite/sandwich repair pages with layered skin/core/cavity and overlap-repair diagrams.
clusters.representative_reason: Figure 3-10 supplies multiple core-replacement forms and a different material/section convention from the wood and metal groups.

clusters.cluster_basis: Chapter 4 metal repair plates for cracked leading/trailing edges, ribs, frames, and fittings.
clusters.representative_reason: Figure 4-21 combines several connected rib/edge repair situations on one plate and is the most varied representative of the local group.

clusters.cluster_basis: Chapter 4 dented-member and welded/finger-patch repair diagrams with repeated patch geometry.
clusters.representative_reason: Figure 4-34 provides repeated finger-patch geometry without selecting the adjacent sleeve-repair pages as duplicates.

clusters.cluster_basis: Chapter 4 tubular-structure splice plates with streamline tubes, sleeves, dimensions, and data tables.
clusters.representative_reason: Figure 4-42 combines close parallel tube geometry with a numeric table and dimensional drafting, maximizing format diversity within the tube group.

clusters.cluster_basis: Chapter 9 compact inspection-figure pages for bolt holes, rod ends, torque tubes, and localized mechanical damage.
clusters.representative_reason: Figures 9-4 through 9-6 provide a multi-figure small-object format not represented by the larger fabrication/repair plates.

clusters.cluster_basis: Appendix A runway/taxiway plan layouts with repeated fixture placements and legend-driven symbols.
clusters.representative_reason: Figure A-6 includes a normal runway with taxiway and provides the broadest connected layout of the local runway-configuration group.

clusters.cluster_basis: Appendix A RGL/stop-bar orientation and holding-position layout plates.
clusters.representative_reason: Figure A-52 adds angular beam lines and runway/taxiway relationships rather than another repeated fixture-placement plan.

clusters.cluster_basis: Appendix A land/hold-short light wireway, pavement, drilling, and cross-section details.
clusters.representative_reason: Figure A-64 is the wireway installation detail; adjacent pages are intentionally not repeated because they share the same standard-detail family.

clusters.cluster_basis: Appendix A MALS wiring and frangible-structure installation pages.
clusters.representative_reason: Figure A-87 combines multi-view structural installation, foundation, conduit, and notes; it is more visually diverse than selecting a wiring-only neighbor.

clusters.cluster_basis: Appendix E REIL/PAPI standard profile and power/control details.
clusters.representative_reason: Figure E-24 provides a profile/detail sheet with foundation, base, conduit, and cable relationships distinct from Appendix A plan and wiring formats.

clusters.cluster_basis: Appendix H legacy runway/stopway lighting figures.
clusters.representative_reason: Figure H-9 preserves a legacy layout convention and avoids selecting several near-identical displaced-threshold/stopway plates.

clusters.cluster_basis: Chapter 2 large-space-system platform/truss conceptual figure pages.
clusters.representative_reason: The geostationary platform page adds an isometric truss situation and avoids selecting adjacent prose/concept pages.

clusters.cluster_basis: Chapter 5 baseline expendable low-thrust OTV concept/profile pages.
clusters.representative_reason: Figure 5-1 is the baseline vehicle overview and is the most useful page-scale structural/equipment layout in this local group.

clusters.cluster_basis: Chapter 5 torus-tank shell, stiffened-skin, frame, and assembly concept pages.
clusters.representative_reason: The page contains alternative structural shell concepts and fabrication discussion, without duplicating the overall OTV profile.

clusters.cluster_basis: Chapter 5 toroidal tank propellant-acquisition/manifold and misalignment diagrams.
clusters.representative_reason: The page provides circular/radial and connected manifold geometry plus a misalignment situation, distinct from shell and linear duct pages.

clusters.cluster_basis: Chapter 5 LH2 tank screened-channel, perforated-plate, and raised-duct detail pages.
clusters.representative_reason: Figure 5-21 is the clearest local representative of fine screen/branch-channel/tank-wall detail and weak scan linework.

clusters.cluster_basis: Chapter 5 installation/deployment envelope and payload-interface figure pages.
clusters.representative_reason: Figure 5-49 adds long-axis deployment and payload envelope geometry, broadening the scan family beyond tank internals and prose.
